privacyBody.pl: Wszystko działa na urządzeniu. Kopia lokalna nie ochroni danych po utracie telefonu — regularnie zapisz ZIP poza nim.
privacyBody.en: Everything works on the device. A local backup will not protect your data after you lose the phone — regularly save the ZIP elsewhere.

backupSaveCancelled.en: External save cancelled. The backup is available in local backups.

notificationsExplain.en: Date reminders: 7 days, 1 day before and on the due date. Android may delay notifications in battery saver mode.
